name: Scholar Reclining and Watching Rising Clouds; Poem by Wang Wei
aliases: 坐看雲起圖; 王維詩
summary: Poem and painting, once mounted together as one fan, exemplify the collaboration between imperial patron and court painter. Emperor Lizong’s calligraphy cites a verse from Wang Wei’s (701–761) poem, Walking to where the water ends, I sit and watch when clouds arise.Ma Lin’s response is this painting
